load_cityscapes_instances: load Cityscapes instance segmentation annotations from image and ground truth directories into Detectron2 format
load_cityscapes_semantic: load Cityscapes semantic segmentation labels from image and ground truth directories into Detectron2 format
get_cityscapes_files: scan Cityscapes dataset directories and return tuples of image, instance, label, and JSON annotation file paths
cityscapes_files_to_dict: parse a single Cityscapes annotation file tuple into a Detectron2 dataset dictionary with bounding boxes and segmentation
run_cityscapes_data_vis: run the module CLI to visualize Cityscapes instance or semantic segmentation annotations and save rendered images
